description: Check a mechanic quote, repair estimate, or bill from an image URL or pasted text against US fair market labor rates and parts benchmarks to find savings. Identifies potential overcharges, checks state statutory inspection fee caps, flags OBD-II diagnostic inconsistencies, and matches active shop coupons or manufacturer rebates to reduce out-of-pocket costs without adversarial confrontation. US only.

image_url.description: URL or base64 data URI of the mechanic quote, invoice, or estimate image/PDF.

text.description: Pasted plain text of the repair estimate, invoice, or list of line items with prices.

vehicle.description: Vehicle details if known. Overrides or supplements details extracted from the document.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code where the repair is quoted. Used for localized labor rates and regional price parity.

name: audit_repair_quote

best_coupon.description: Highest-value coupon or discount found for this repair job.

clunker_alert.description: Warning if the repair quote exceeds 50% of the vehicle value.

coupon_savings.description: Dollar savings specifically from active coupons or promotions.

is_car_sale.description: True if the quote was detected as a car sales/purchase quote rather than auto repair.

is_international.description: True if the quote was detected as non-US or non-USD.

items.description: Line-by-line audit of each repair task on the bill.

market_position.description: How the total quote compares to fair market benchmarks.

potential_savings.description: Actionable savings in USD available through verified coupons or rebates.

summary.description: Human-readable breakdown of the audit, line item verdicts, and actionable deal savings.

total_quoted.description: Total price quoted on the document in USD.

title: Check Repair Quote for Savings & Deals
